text:
maya: Quick heads-up — localization smoke found a 403 on /kb/assets/banner-hero.png in fr and de builds. Also the canonical link on /kb/setup/quickstart points to /docs/old-setup which 404s. Anyone own those pages?
chris: On it — I maintain /kb/setup. Which canonical link exactly? can you paste the snippet from the page?
maya: Here's the meta tag we saw: <link rel="canonical" href="/docs/old-setup">. Failing image is via CDN: https://cdn.redwood.ai/kb/assets/banner-hero.png (curl returns 403).
docs-bot: Automated check detected CDN-origin error in eu-west-1 — created ticket #CDN-1423.
sam: I can take the canonical link fix. I'll open a tiny PR to update to /kb/setup/quickstart and adjust frontmatter if needed. Assign to me.
anna: I saw a similar 403 last week; suspect bucket policy. tagging @eng-infra for visibility.
jordan: eng-infra here — will investigate. If it's a signed-url/ACL issue we can patch quickly. can you paste the curl -I output?
maya: curl -I 'https://cdn.redwood.ai/kb/assets/banner-hero.png' => HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Also will attach a screenshot in the PR for localization QA.
chris: sam — ping when PR ready, I'll review. anna/jordan if infra does a fix, i'll re-run the localization job: `./scripts/localize --check fr,de`
sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwoodinc/kb/commit/abcd1234 — frontmatter tweak + canonical updated. requesting review from @chris @maya
chris: :thumbsup: reviewing now.
jordan: infra update: found missing ACL rule for objects under the 'kb' prefix in eu-west-1. applied patch, invalidated edge cache for the prefix. please retry curl.
maya: Retry: curl -I 'https://cdn.redwood.ai/kb/assets/banner-hero.png' => HTTP/1.1 200 OK — good now, thanks! localization job rerun queued.
docs-bot: Localization job #LZ-889 finished: fr deploy succeeded, de failed (missing translation keys).
sam: noted — i'll open a follow-up PR for the de translations. Also propose adding owners metadata to the assets page so future alerts route to docs: add `owner: @docs` in frontmatter.
anna: +1, owners frontmatter would make alert routing much easier. please PR the tiny change.
maya: Created follow-up issue: https://github.com/redwoodinc/kb/issues/321 — tagging docs and eng-infra.
chris: Summary/action items: sam merged canonical fix; jordan fixed CDN ACL; sam to submit de translations PR; anna to add owners frontmatter. i'll close the follow-ups once PRs are merged. Thanks all.
